This page is a curated map of **where to go** to discuss different parts of this project. GitHub Discussions is a flat list of threads per category; the structure you see below is maintained by hand and updated as new threads emerge.

## How to contribute — quick decision tree

| I want to... | Use... |
|---|---|
| Comment on a specific line, paragraph, parameter, or equation | [**Hypothesis**](https://hypothes.is/) — click the `<` tab on the right edge of any dashboard page |
| Ask a longer question or propose a correction | The relevant **GitHub Discussion** thread below |
| Report a bug or code-level issue | [**GitHub Issues**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/issues) |
| Discuss workshop sessions or cross-PQ structure | The **Workshop** or **Pivotal Questions** categories below |

Reading GitHub Discussions is open to everyone; posting requires a free GitHub account.

---

## 💬 Workshop {#workshop}

**Hub:** [Workshop discussion hub (#2)](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/2) · category: **General**

Session prep, agenda, follow-ups, and broader workshop-level discussion tied to the [April 2026 Cultivated Meat PQ Workshop](https://uj-cm-workshop.netlify.app/).

**Active sub-threads:** *(None yet. Open a new thread in the General category and it will be linked here.)*

---

## 🔬 Model {#model}

**Hub:** [Model discussion hub (#3)](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/3) · category: **Q&A** (supports "marked answer")

Parameters, equations, methodology, alternative data sources, and comparison with other TEAs. Model-level discussion of sub-questions **CM_12–CM_20** (hydrolysates, growth factors, media, cell density, food-grade vs pharma, bioreactors) lives here too.

| # | Thread | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| [**#9**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/9) | Is pharma-grade media at $0.50–2.50/L defensible for 2036? | Media cost; CM_14 / CM_15 / CM_17 |
| [**#10**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/10) | Is the maturity-factor correlation too strong? | Correlation structure; WACC / CAPEX / tech coupling |

*Open a new Q&A thread for any additional model topic.*
